aiExplanation: This algorithm counts the number of **distinct subsequences** in a string using dynamic programming. It maintains `dp[i]` to represent the count of distinct subsequences up to position `i`, starting with 1 (the empty subsequence). For each character, it **doubles** `dp[i]` since every existing subsequence can either include or exclude this character—but then it **subtracts** the count from when this character last appeared (`dp[last[pos]]`) to eliminate duplicate subsequences. By tracking the last position of each letter in the `last` array, the algorithm avoids counting the same subsequence twice. Finally, it returns the result minus 1 to exclude the empty subsequence.
